title: observability: token-level KV metrics + cost/latency dashboard improvements and alert tuning
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: token-level KV cache behavior and per-token cost/latency visibility have been high-value signals for debugging serving regressions and optimizing batching/quantization policies. This PR adds additional token-level KV metrics, extends the cost/latency breakdowns to per-model-route dashboards, and tunes alert thresholds to reduce noise while preserving SLOs. Changes include new Prometheus metrics, tracing spans for KV hit/miss paths, Grafana dashboard panels with token-level histograms, and alert rule adjustments based on recent incident postmortems. Checklist: - Add token-level KV metrics (kv_token_hits_total, kv_token_misses_total, kv_token_hit_latency_seconds) - Emit span attributes for KV lookup path and cache key size - Update Grafana dashboards: route-level panels for token cost, token latency P50/P95/P99, KV hit ratio histograms - Add alert tuning: reduce false positives by incorporating sustained-window and dynamic thresholds for cold-start scenarios - Add docs and runbook snippets under observability/runbooks/kv-token-metrics.md - Add integration tests to ensure metrics are emitted in the serving runtime and end-to-end dashboards show data Notes: this is a follow-up to ENG-4823 to capture per-route skew and to ENG-4901 for alert refinements. The description below contains implementation details, testing notes, and rollout plan.

review_comments: Samir Gupta: Please add histogram buckets rationale in the metrics file; the 16/64/256 buckets may underrepresent tail cases.
Maya Patel (author): Added a comment explaining bucket selection and an additional large bucket for extreme tails. Also added integration test coverage for P99 behavior.
Elena Rossi: Alert tuning looks good, but can we add a short cooldown after deploy to avoid deploy-related noise?
Maya Patel (author): Added a 10-minute cooldown window for alert evaluation in the alert rules and documented the behavior in the runbook.
Noah Chen: Minor nits on dashboard layout and panel titles; requested consistent unit labels (tokens/ms and tokens/$).
Maya Patel (author): Fixed titles and added unit labels across panels.
testing_notes: Unit tests added for metrics increment paths and tracing emission. Integration test runs a local serving instance with a synthetic workload to validate that kv_token_hits_total and latency histograms appear in Prometheus and that Grafana dashboard ingestion script applies dashboards successfully. CI showed a flaky integration test on first run (timeout on test harness) which was mitigated by increasing wait time and adding retries. All checks passed on rerun.
rollout_plan: Gradual rollout: 1) deploy metrics/tracing and exporter to staging; 2) deploy dashboards and alert rules to observability-staging; 3) monitor for 48h; 4) deploy to prod observability by toggling config flag observability.enable_kv_token_metrics; 5) keep alert in email-only mode for first 24h, then enable PagerDuty if stable. If increased noise observed, rollback by disabling feature flag.
release_notes: Added token-level KV metrics and per-route token cost/latency dashboards; tuned KV-miss and token-latency alerts to reduce noise. No breaking changes. Runbook added for KV-token incidents.
notes: This PR is part of ongoing observability improvements for cost and latency transparency. It reduces mean time to detect for KV-related regressions and provides engineers with per-route breakdowns to optimize batching and quantization strategies.
